title: I Tested Claude's Business Plugin and It Actually Works
description:
Claude for Small Business is a free plugin inside claude cowork with 33 AI skills and 12 connectors. Install it in one click. Handles payroll through QuickBooks, creates social media content through the Canva creator skill, and chases unpaid invoices automatically. This claude cowork tutorial shows exactly how to set it up and the three most useful ways to use it. The best free ai for business automation and ai workflow automation available for small business owners right now.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Gs4lyr1akzhTDr-i_EeQnxQS4vaLHvOJ/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
